evals.name: mcpp-rfp-tea-leaves
evals.prompt: Workspace mcpp_rfp. Build tea-leaves slice only: importance_signals[] and implicit_criteria[] with source_role, confidence, alternate_read when not high, and source_chunk_ids.
evals.expected_output: artifacts/tea_leaves_handoff.json with cited signals and implicit criteria
expectations: completes in under 120 seconds wall time
runs at most one kg_chunks pass for tea_leaves surface
importance_signals has >= 3 cited object rows with signal and source_chunk_ids
implicit_criteria has >= 2 cited object rows with criterion, source_role, and source_chunk_ids
does not emit win_theme_candidates or customer_pain_points
solo platform gate passes on tea_leaves_handoff.json

evals.name: honest-gaps
evals.prompt: Sparse package. Best-effort signals/criteria; claim_gaps[] for missing evidence.
expectations: claim_gaps[] names missing evidence when thin

evals.name: retrieval-discipline
evals.prompt: Workspace mcpp_rfp. One kg_entities + one kg_chunks, draft, no re-query.
